{{Top|leg}}
'''Gyylghrard's journal''' was a record of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] inmate [[Gyylghrard]]'s incarceration on the [[Kessel Correctional Facility]]. It was written with a stylus on several pieces of [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsi]] he received from his [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] friend in exchange for his protection.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030501kessel|text=Kessel: Hell in Space|int=Kessel: Hell in Space}}</ref>

It detailed the treatment of the slave miners at the hands of the officials, including Gyylghrard's interactions with [[Moruth Doole]]. It was also one of the few sources regarding the [[Life Day massacre|Life Day Massacre]] and his participation in it. The journal ends prior to his second inclusion to [[Dewt Kluskine]]'s honor guard, where he decapitated the [[Warden/Legends|warden]] with a [[ceremonial poleaxe]] in revenge for ordering the massacre.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />

The journal was kept safe by a fellow prisoner after Gyylghrard's death. It recently came to light during [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] failed attempt to reopen the mining operation.<ref name="Kessel: Hell in Space" />
